simple.meaning: the constellation of the Great Bear (perhaps from its migration through the heavens)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עַיִשׁ (H5906) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עַיִשׁ (ʻAyish) means the constellation of the Great Bear (perhaps from its migration through the heavens) First listed occurrence: Job 9 9.

definitions.short: the constellation of the Great Bear (perhaps from its migration through the heavens)
definitions.full: H5906. Ayish or Ash עַ֫יִשׁ noun feminine a constellation, perhaps Great Bear (compare especially Di) (point perh, עִיֻּשׁ (see Bu and references), compare Syriac PS 2866 , Brock., name of a star); — ׳וְע עַלבָּֿנֶיהָ Job 38:22 = עָשׁ 9:9 (both + כְּסִיל כִּימָה, etc.). עַיָּת proper name, of a location see ׳עַ
